_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: CLEAN POP PLAZA leaderboard stand. Origin on the floor under the middle; front = +Y here (Roblox -Z after the usual lookAt). Frame 12 wide x 7 tall (1.1 to 8.1 above the floor), header plate 7 x 1.8 on the top edge, crown top about 11.1. Put the list SurfaceGui on an invisible 10 x 5 part at textFace.center and the title on a 6 x 1.1 part at headerFace.center. Suggested spot: hub (-40, 0, -43) turned to face the spawn, or wherever the leaderboard wall placeholder is.

textFace.note: flat cream face for the list; corners rounded 0.6

headerFace.note: flat blue front of the header plate, for the title (white text)

CleanLeaderboard_Glow.note: thin light line just inside the frame
